name: C2Pay
tagline: A mobile payments SDK that raises authentication only for risky transactions, using signed content credentials and device keys.

awards: Best Financial Hack by Capital One

problem: Generative AI makes fabricated content and identities easier, threatening payment trust.
solution: Collects device, behaviour and biometric signals into a risk score; above a threshold, escalates to verification with C2PA manifests and hardware-backed keys, giving merchants verifiable proof.
demo_moment: Team-described: simulate payments at several risk levels and verify one as the merchant.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Financial Hack by Capital One” among 160 submissions.

lessons: Borrow a standard from another field to make a trust claim verifiable.
